goal.en: In a fresh short phone context, identify a name and phone number without a transcript; confirm by selection or oral check.
goal.ar: أن تسجل اسم وعمر ورقم هاتف ويوم من رسالة صوتية جديدة بدقة.

scope.performance: two listens with optional repair, no transcript

video.english_pronunciation: General American with inline SSML IPA

variants.teach_back: Explain why thirteen/thirty or grouped phone digits can change recorded meaning.

privacy: The learner may use fictional safe information.
No microphone permission or raw-answer retention is required.
accessibility: Every spoken model has visible text.
Colour is never the only feedback signal.
Arabic and English reading directions are explicit.

bounded_scope_notes: Retrieve numbers 0-100; preserve individual digit order in phone numbers.
Recognise and retrieve all seven day names in a fresh contact message.
Use grouping, selected high-vowel contrasts, and teen/ty stress only to preserve key detail.
Recycle spelling, repair, and selected dental sounds in names, three, and Thursday.
